user.description: $ Building data pipelines, analytics systems, and reporting solutions that turn raw data into decisions.

about.heading: Engineering intelligence into everything I build.
paragraphs: I'm a Data Science graduate from Ramaiah University, Bengaluru, working at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and analytics. I enjoy building systems that turn raw, complex data into reliable pipelines, useful insights, and intelligent applications.

Currently, I'm an Azure Data Science Intern at Cloudalytix, working with Microsoft Fabric and its data ecosystem across OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Factory, Warehouses, and Power BI. I'm also a Microsoft certified Fabric Data Engineer Associate.

My projects span applied machine learning, large-scale data processing, and analytics, including an AML platform processing 100K+ transactions and a probabilistic Bundesliga prediction system built with ensemble learning and time-series validation. I'm most comfortable working with Python, SQL, FastAPI, Supabase, Microsoft Fabric, and AWS.

contact.message: Open to full-time roles, internships, and interesting collaborations in data science, ML engineering, and risk analytics. Based in Bengaluru — remote-capable.

projects.name: SPIELTAG — BUNDESLIGA PREDICTOR
projects.description: Stacking ensemble ML architecture with Optuna hyperparameter tuning. Aggregated 10 seasons of xG JSON, CSV, and REST API data into a unified training set. Meta-model: Multinomial Logistic Regression (Log Loss: 0.9702). Live React dashboard powered by Supabase real-time backend.

projects.name: RAG APPLICATION
projects.description: Production-style Retrieval-Augmented Generation system using FastAPI. Sentence-transformer embeddings with top-K context selection for cost-aware inference. Integrated AWS Bedrock (Titan LLM) with secure IAM roles and async inference. Full-stack monorepo — backend on Render, frontend on Vercel.

bullets: Built and executed data integration and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Fabric components, working with structured data across ingestion and analytics workflows.
Applied data modeling and transformation concepts to prepare data for reporting and analysis using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
Gained practical experience with Azure cloud infrastructure and data services.
Built a full-stack AML training platform simulating Financial Intelligence Unit workflows for forensic accounting students, using React, Express.js, FastAPI, and Supabase.
Engineered an 8-rule AML detection engine in Python processing 100K+ transactions, implementing rules for Structuring, Layering (graph cycle detection), Velocity Spikes, and Geographic Risk.
Developed an unsupervised ML ensemble (Isolation Forest + K-Means) with SHAP explainability for transaction anomaly scoring, producing tri-level risk classification per transaction.
Integrated live sanctions screening against 100+ global watchlists (OFAC, UN, EU, HMT) and built an end-to-end SAR case management workflow with in-browser PDF report generation.
Implemented JWT-based RBAC across 4 user roles with per-user data isolation, ensuring each trainee operates in a sandboxed environment with an HMAC-signed audit log for tamper-evident record keeping.
Engineered a 100K+ image dataset for human detection by programmatically curating and processing the COCO dataset.
Applied bounding box annotations and systematic augmentations, improving model accuracy by over 20%.
Evaluated and benchmarked 3+ deep learning models on a 20K image sample to identify the optimal deployment architecture.
Implemented MobileNetV2 transfer learning (ImageNet), freezing base layers and customising the classifier — achieving 92%+ accuracy.
Built interactive dashboards using Python and Power BI to deliver clear, actionable project metrics.
Coursework spanning ML, deep learning, statistical modelling, time series analysis, and data engineering.
Built and shipped production-ready ML and fullstack projects as part of coursework and independent study.
